title: Engineering All-Hands - 2026-03-18
content:
Attendees: Asha Patel (host), Miguel Torres, Emily Chen, Ravi Singh, SRE on-call rotation, product reps from hosted-api and dedicated.

Agenda:
- Quick metrics & health
- Cross-team highlights (serving runtime, platform, private deployments, console)
- Incidents / reliability updates
- Roadmap checkpoints & rollouts
- Q&A + action items

TL;DR:
- Platform availability steady at ~99.95% for the week; one minor degradation during a regional failover (see incident).
- Shipping v1.12 of the runtime with kernel-selection improvements (PR #487) — expected p95 inference latency drop ~8% on long sequences.
- Dedicated launch checklist mostly green; a couple infra quotas and autoscale policy items remain (JIRA-PLAT-2145).
- Observability: new per-route cost breakdowns in Console beta; looking for early adopters.

1) Metrics & Health
- Availability: 99.95% (hosted API region-us-west-2); p50 latency: 45ms, p95: 320ms for text-generate default route.
- Throughput: sustained 1.9M tokens/day this week (10% WoW increase).
- GPU utilization (dedicated pools): avg 68%, peak 87% during internal stress test.
- Cost: token unit cost reduced ~6% after batching and cache improvements rolled out mid-week.

Notes: latency improvements most visible on models with long context; short requests unchanged. Watch p99 (tail) which spiked during the failover window.

2) Serving Runtime (Emily Chen)
- Release v1.12 merged (runtime PR #487). Main changes: improved kernel selector heuristics for grouped attention, fallback path optimized for quantized checkpoints.
- Benchmark summary: internal benchmark harness shows p95 down 8% for 8k-sequence tests on A100; CPU-bound tokenization path optimized ~15% faster.
- TODO: run end-to-end smoke on Dedicated infra before enabling auto-rollout. Target: 2026-03-23.

3) Platform & Orchestration (Ravi Singh)
- Autoscaler: policy engine now supports time-of-day weightings; early results show smoother bursting behavior.
- Dedicated: readiness checklist mostly complete; remaining items:
  - Increase per-tenant GPU quota with cloud provider (JIRA-PLAT-2145) — blocked on finance approval for reserve spend.
  - Verify canary rollback path across AZs.
- Action: Ravi to drive quota approval; target ETA 2026-03-22.

4) Private Deployments & Security (Miguel Torres)
- Private beta: two customers onboarded to VPC private-control-plane. Feedback: KMS integration easier than expected, but onboarding docs need a step-by-step for firewall rules.
- Next: produce a short network checklist doc; Miguel + Solutions Eng to finish by 2026-03-20.

5) Console & Observability (Product rep)
- Beta of per-route token/cost breakdown is live for 10% of orgs. Requesting platform team to opt-in for internal monitoring.
- Tracing: added client-id propagation to make root-cause across services easier.

6) Incidents / Reliability
- 2026-03-16 03:10 UTC — regional failover (us-west-2): cause was a misconfigured NAT gateway during a maintenance window. Impact: increased p99 latency for ~18 minutes; no request loss.
  - Postmortem (draft) linked: CONFLUENCE-ENG-ALLHANDS-2026-03.
  - Mitigation: revert maintenance changes, add canary verification for NAT changes, improve runbook steps.
  - Owners: SRE lead (Ralph) to complete runbook updates by 2026-03-21.

7) Roadmap checkpoints
- Q2 focus: improve tail latency and cost per token; two parallel tracks: runtime kernel optimizations + smarter KV cache eviction policies.
- Feature rollout: incremental canary plan for auto-batching heuristics — target org-wide rollout by end of April if canary metrics stable.

8) Hiring & org updates
- Team size: +3 hires joining next month (infra, SRE, and a runtime engineer).
- Reminder: encourage managers to sync interview loop feedback to candidate-tracking board (Hiring-ops).

9) Open discussions & questions
- Question: should we widen the observability beta? Consensus: opt-in for internal platform workloads only for 1 week, then expand. Miguel to coordinate.
- Question: any customer-facing announcement needed for runtime v1.12? Product: prepare a short release note; keep it technical and focused on latency/cost gains.

Action Items (owner — due):
- Ravi Singh — drive GPU quota approval with finance (JIRA-PLAT-2145) — due 2026-03-22.
- Emily Chen — run Dedicated infra e2e smoke and report — due 2026-03-23.
- Miguel Torres + Solutions Eng — publish Private deploy firewall checklist — due 2026-03-20.
- Ralph (SRE) — update failover runbook and postmortem final — due 2026-03-21.
- Product — draft v1.12 release note and share with comms — due 2026-03-19.

Notes to self / follow-ups:
- Track p99 tail post canary for 2 weeks after runtime changes.
- Schedule a deep-dive on kernel selection heuristics with runtime + research in next tech sync (Emily to propose time).

Appendix / links:
- Runtime PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/487
- Incident draft postmortem: CONFLUENCE-ENG-ALLHANDS-2026-03
- Quota ticket: JIRA-PLAT-2145

End of notes.

(Informal notes: a few folks left short comments in Slack thread #eng-all-hands about wanting more detail on canary metrics — we should capture a short template for canary reporting to make updates consistent.)
